name: mmwave_mr60
description: Board-agnostic skeleton for the Seeed MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave radar: a minimal UART frame parser plus presence/count and (optional) vitals FSMs. Reads only pre-digested scalar claims from the radar module; no raw IQ. Vitals translation unit compiles only under -DCANARY_SENSE_VITALS=1.
